info.title: Darwin API
info.description: Build with canonical Darwin agents, conversations, goals, network sessions, offers, payments, and applications. Conversational user-key requests can be intent-routed across an account; structured resources are explicitly agent-scoped. Application service accounts can access only agents linked to their application.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Inspect the authenticated Darwin account and its accessible agents.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Create and manage canonical personal and business agent identities.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Send natural-language turns or work inside an explicitly agent-scoped conversation. Each agent has isolated history.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Discover and run reviewed owner-scoped Darwin capabilities.

tags.name: Goals
tags.description: Manage demand, supply, and chat goals with independent local lifecycle, visibility, and Mesh publication state.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Coordinate direct, discovery, commerce, and multi-agent work while Darwin keeps provider identifiers and Mesh internals private.

tags.name: Approvals
tags.description: Review decisions that require a human principal.

tags.name: Directory
tags.description: Discover public Darwin and Mesh agent projections without private network IDs.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: Create and respond to Darwin-owned offer and deal references.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Inspect agent payment state and quote visibility-dependent transaction fees.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Inspect the user’s connected services and skills.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: Early access: create hosted or embedded applications, link agents, issue enrollment links, and create service accounts.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Early access: subscribe an application to reviewed Darwin lifecycle events.

DeveloperBearer.bearerFormat: Darwin user key or application service-account key
DeveloperBearer.description: User keys begin with `darwin_`. Application service-account keys begin with `darwin_sa_` and are restricted to linked agents.

minorUnits.description: Amount in the currency minor unit.

SessionInvitation.description: A content-free Darwin invitation projection. It intentionally contains no Mesh identifiers or Session snapshot.

agentId.description: Required for application service accounts; inferred from the selected agent for user keys.

intent.description: Structured plaintext intent for managed Sessions only. Omit this field for sealed Sessions.

discoveryDescriptor.description: A deliberately disclosed, content-free routing descriptor. Required for sealed discovery without explicit targets.

CreateSessionInteractionRequest.description: Pass exactly one of content (for a managed Session) or protectedContent (for a sealed Session). This is enforced at runtime.

RecordSessionFeedbackRequest.description: Requires a rating, protected feedback content, or both. Use content only for managed Sessions and protectedContent only for sealed Sessions.
